subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should unpinned `systemEvent` cron requests with explicit channel delivery be accepted by converting them into isolated `agentTurn` jobs, or must callers explicitly choose an isolated agent-turn payload and session target?
rationale: The patch accepts a formerly invalid composition by changing both session and payload semantics; source inspection cannot determine whether that is the intended permanent public cron contract.

options.title: Support concrete announce targets only
options.body: Accept the narrowly useful form only when a concrete delivery target is supplied, keep targetless mode-only announce requests invalid, and document/test the conversion semantics.

options.title: Require explicit isolated jobs
options.body: Keep the current validation boundary and require callers to submit an isolated `agentTurn` job when they want channel delivery.

options.title: Add first-class system-event delivery
options.body: Design a dedicated delivery path that preserves system-event semantics rather than converting the payload into an agent turn.

recommendation.title: Support concrete announce targets only
recommendation.body: Accept the narrowly useful form only when a concrete delivery target is supplied, keep targetless mode-only announce requests invalid, and document/test the conversion semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron delivery and target-validation history makes this contributor the strongest available routing candidate for the contract decision.
